features.note: VERIFIED BY DRIVING IT, not by reading the source. probe-state clicked btnA then btnB in sequence and returned errors:[]; the build carries console.assert(!(openA && openB)), so a clean console after that sequence is positive evidence that no both-open state is reachable. Opening either leaf visibly closes the other in the panel state as well.

The 1.8 m figure inside a 1.000 m drum reads immediately: the occupant fills the volume, and there is visibly no room for a second person. This is the anti-piggybacking argument made geometrically rather than written in the HUD.
Both bands are unmistakable at hero scale, at 900 and 1500 mm, and they wrap the fixed glazing and the leaves alike. They are also what gives the glass drum a readable scale.

The glazing reads AS glass — the occupant, the far mullions and the floor tread are all legible through it, and the drum is not a black cylinder. transmission 0.72 with depthWrite:false; at 0.96 the glass would have vanished.

Lowest critical feature and the honest one. The leaf IS parked rather than deleted — it is on the drum at a different azimuth in the abierta capture — but glass sliding behind glass is a low-contrast event, so the open state reads mostly by the mullion positions and the panel indicator rather than by an obvious change. See defects.

important_features.note: 300 mm canopy with its lip, and the sensor head visible against the lit ceiling through the glazing.
Reader pedestal outside door A with an emissive face, and the exit button inside. Both small at hero scale but unambiguous in the grazing view.

defects: The open state is low-contrast: a glazed leaf sliding behind glazed fixed segments changes little in pixels, so `abierta` reads primarily by mullion position and the panel indicator rather than by an obvious silhouette change. This is a property of a transparent product, not a modelling error, but it means the kinematic capture carries less on its own than the equivalent capture on porton-corredizo did.

Occupancy is 22%: a subject 1.21 m wide and 2.40 m tall cannot fill a landscape frame. Forcing it would mean the diagonal composition that porton-corredizo's spec documents as the trap, so the low number is deliberate.
The figure's arms sit close to the torso and largely disappear behind it at the hero azimuth; the figure reads as a person but not a posed one.

mechanical.note: Console-clean read from all THREE capture sidecars (neutral, grazing, abierta), each console_clean:true with an empty issues array, PLUS a fourth clean run from probe-state driving both interlocked doors. probe.mjs medians 74 draws / 8,268 tris against a budget of 90 / 200,000. No test suite, so tests is null. colorTarget anchored by projected geometry on the aluminium canopy (the largest UNGLAZED metal surface — a glass crop would move whenever the interior does); two nested crops agreed, dE00 0.29. TWO DEFECTS WERE CAUGHT BEFORE THIS REVIEW: (1) PREFLIGHT caught a ReferenceError — the initial applyDoors() call sat in the temporal dead zone of `const requestRender`; the module threw, so data-app-ready would never have flipped and the gate would have scored the asset as broken after spending the attempt. Every sibling survives the same ordering only because its handlers run on a click, never at load. (2) The PRE-LOOK caught a 0.125 m gap between the figure's torso and head — a floating head; fixed with a longer torso plus a neck, both joints now asserted. DEVIATIONS: the reviewer is the ORCHESTRATOR INLINE, not a fresh-context blind agent (this session cannot spawn subagents), so this verdict is a SELF-REVIEW and not the acceptance authority GATES.md requires; the `neutral` view is deliberately the default camera; no `reference-match` view exists (p6_comparison: spec-only). SEPARATE FINDING, reported not fixed: a sweep of all catalog specs found 89 valid and 9 unparseable, in estructuras and transporte — other families, left untouched per the isolation rule.
